title: Sources & further reading
body:
Restaurant bookings and prices came directly from each venue's own reservation page — Nihonryori RyuGin, Ginza Ukai-tei, Kobikicho Ohno, and TableCheck listings for Aragawa and Yakiniku Ushigoro, plus HotPepper Gourmet listings for Torien and Uobei Genki Sushi.

Entry rules from Japan National Tourism Organization (mofa.go.jp itself blocked automated verification — reconfirm there before departure). Transit fares from PASMO, Keisei Skyliner, and Haneda access guide. ATM guidance from Seven Bank. Tipping and dining etiquette from JNTO and Japan Guide; the Nov 1, 2026 tax-free system change from JNTO.

Sight hours and prices from each venue's own site — Senso-ji, Meiji Jingu (forest history from its own forest page), teamLab Planets, Shinjuku Gyoen, and Tokyo Tower. Market status from Tsukiji Outer Market and the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market (Tsukiji crowd-timing corroborated by two independent Japanese-language firsthand accounts). Ameya-Yokocho's shop count and area from its own site. Public holidays from the Cabinet Office's own calendar.
